---
title: "Overall survival — primary model fitting"
subtitle: "Bayesian proportional hazards model with a five-df M-spline baseline"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The SAP model is fitted independently to each of the 50 completed datasets.
Each Stan fit is its own recoverable branch (four chains, 4,000 iterations).

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "survival-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
indices <- module_exact_indices(config)
input_dir <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "imputations")
model_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "models"))
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "survival-helpers.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"),
  here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"), knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-os-models
#| include: false
for (index in indices) {
  input_path <- file.path(input_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  output_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  if (!file.exists(input_path)) stop("Missing OS imputation branch: ", input_path)
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("primary-os-fitting-%02d", index),
    input_paths = input_path,
    output_paths = output_path,
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(endpoint = "overall_survival", imputation = index,
                   chains = 4L, iterations = 4000L, warmup = 2000L),
    worker = function() {
      data <- module_read_parquet(input_path)
      module_require_columns(
        data,
        c("survival_time_days", "event_death", "tx", "ecog_binary",
          "stage_binary", "lung", "mgps"),
        "OS imputation branch"
      )
      data$mgps <- factor(data$mgps, levels = 0:2)
      formula <- survival::Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~
        tx + ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps
      fit <- rstanarm::stan_surv(
        formula = formula,
        data = data,
        basehaz = "ms",
        basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
        prior = rstanarm::normal(location = rep(0, 6), scale = c(0.55, rep(2.5, 5))),
        prior_intercept = rstanarm::normal(0, 20),
        prior_aux = rstanarm::dirichlet(1),
        chains = 4L,
        cores = 4L,
        iter = 4000L,
        warmup = 2000L,
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "survival", index)
      )
      module_save_rds(fit, output_path)
    }
  )
}
model_paths <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", indices))
if (length(model_paths) != 50L || !all(file.exists(model_paths))) {
  stop("OS fitting stage did not produce all 50 model branches.")
}
```
